title: VidaFire
description: A personal finance and FIRE planning platform built to turn daily financial decisions into long-term independence scenarios. VidaFire combines authenticated budget tracking, transaction history, localized currency defaults, simulation paths, and cloud-native delivery so users can understand how today's habits affect tomorrow's optionality.
